shared_elements: tall upright stone monument bearing carved relief
horizontal band(s) of motifs across the upper-middle of the surface
justification: Both show a tall upright stone whose upper portion carries schematic, outline-carved motifs organised into horizontal bands, including a row of repeated small shapes and long curved arcs, which is about as generic a correspondence as decorated standing stones can produce. The decisive difference is that B depicts an anthropomorphic being — a head with eyes and brows, a headdress of paired vertical elements, shoulders and a ring/disc on the chest — whereas A depicts no figure at all, only an abstract banded field (boat- or vessel-like) with a row of hook signs and a zigzag border.
